explanation: CROSS JOIN UNNEST(event_params) AS p names each parameter p, the key filter keeps the value row, COALESCE reads whichever slot is filled, and the _TABLE_SUFFIX range reads only October's tables. A range on event_date gives the same total but reads every daily table first; double_value alone misses the purchases sent in int_value; and AS t(p) is DuckDB's way to name the element, not BigQuery's.
